observations.walk_rule: prev = sentinel; node = head; for i in 0..4: t = slot(node); if i == 4 or t != prev: invoke t(node), store result, return 1; else prev = t, node = [node + 0x38]. The receiver of the invoked slot is the node whose slot differed (or the fifth node on the fall-through path).

unknowns: Domain meaning of the chain, the head pointer, and the three slots is not claimed.
The invoked slots are class-dependent virtual functions; their implementations are left by contract, as is the rest of each sentinel function beyond its verified prefix.
Indirect-branch callers, if any, are not covered by the census; the census covers direct calls, tail jumps, stored qwords, and RELATIVE addends only.
A chain that ends before the walk resolves is not modelled as a return: the native code would dereference a null vtable pointer, so the model raises instead of inventing a result.
